Additions: Id: lesson_specific_carrot_sharing
Scope: story
Title: <PERSON> shares her carrot
Plain: <PERSON> willingly shares or divides her favorite carrot with a friend instead of keeping it all to herself.
Rubric: Review the full story. <PERSON> must intentionally share or divide her signature carrot (or a snack made from it) with another character. Return a violation if <PERSON> eats the whole carrot alone, refuses to share it, or loses it without a deliberate act of sharing.
Repair Hint: Have <PERSON> break her carrot in half or offer a bite to another character who is hungry or sad.
Id: lesson_specific_joy_in_giving
Scope: story
Title: Mutual happiness through sharing
Plain: Both <PERSON> and the character she shares with must visibly show joy as a direct result of sharing.
Rubric: Review the story resolution after the act of sharing. The recipient must feel happy/relieved, and <PERSON> must explicitly feel happier or content because she shared. Return a violation if <PERSON> regrets sharing, feels resentful, or if the act fails to bring shared happiness.
Repair Hint: Show <PERSON> smiling brightly and expressing how good it feels to enjoy a treat together with her friend.

Rules: simple words; each question is one short sentence and ends with a question mark; each answer is at most 12 words; every question has one right answer and two plausible but clearly wrong ones that are gentle and never scary; use the hero's name; never use words from any drawing.
